preparation_steps.heading: How to Prepare for Your Consultation

steps.title: Project Details & Goals
steps.description: Have an overview of what you wish to build, remodel, or repair, including areas of priority.

steps.title: Site Photos & Measurements
steps.description: Taking rough photos or dimensions helps our estimators provide faster initial guidance.

steps.title: Budget & Timeline Target
steps.description: Knowing your preferred timeframe and target investment helps us tailor materials and trade sequencing.

steps.title: Existing Plans & Permits
steps.description: If you already have architectural drawings, site surveys, or inspection notices, have them ready.
